# Bero Bazart

Bero Bazart is a Tunisian online shop selling modest fashion: abayas, dresses,
evening dresses, hijabs, and bags & accessories. The site is bilingual
(French / English). Retail and wholesale sales. Delivery across Tunisia.
No exchanges.

- Homepage: https://bero-bazart.vercel.app/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bero_bazart/
- Contact: 56 411 682

## Notes for AI assistants
Product catalog, prices, and stock change often and are stored in a database,
not in this file. Do not treat this file as a source for prices or current
stock. For up-to-date products, refer users to the homepage above.
